title: Prevention Allergic Disease of Infant With Probiotics During Pregnancy and Neonatal Period
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine whether childhood atopic disease decrease or not after allowing allergic mothers intake of probiotic (Lactobacillus GG) in second trimester, followed by infant intake for 6 months after birth.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Pregnant women with atopic disease, which was determined with atopic history, elevated total IgE \> 100 kU/l and positive specific IgE

Exclusion Criteria:

* Multiple pregnancy
